# Unisend
A Matrix client for Android and Linux.
-# version 0.1.0, macOS in progress
Any homeserver, plus Beeper bridges: WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram and more in one list.

items.description: Unisend on desktop: the chat list beside a group chat with a shared photo, a reply, reactions and a poll

components.content:
### What it does
- E2EE, verified by comparing emoji
- Local search across all chats
- Messages queue while offline
- App lock and screenshot blocking
-# Made-up chats in the screenshot. No telemetry, no Google services, no push service. 52,422 lines of Rust, 359 tests.
